title: Whispers from the Liminal — ep. 18 · a field guide, left on a park bench

nodes.text: WHISPERS FROM THE LIMINAL · ep. 18 · a field guide, left on a park bench
A field guide written by a student, left on a park bench. Plasteek pages, slick and glowy with rain, animated menus and transitions unspooling in an endless loop.
some part of you finds a hole, and crawls into.

arrive at a time in life where all answers dry up
days stretch long &
night creeps into a stretch of- well- forever.

relationships dried out like butcher paper onion skin
a future tense that’s all but spent.

come with me prolapsed children of the mind.
the soma solipsism hurts only so much as you want it to.
